harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up automated one-way sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, using SSH (enabled sshd on both nodes, generated host keys, deployed the cluster SSH keypair for passwordless auth) and a root cron job on node2 (*/5 * * * *) running /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh, which rsyncs the file from node1 and only replaces the local copy when content differs (via cmp), logging via syslog. Verified propagation of a real edit within one 5-minute cron tick (well under the 15-minute requirement), both before and after restarting each node. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, sshd/cron active, app.conf checksum) on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id and boot time changed after reboot, and confirmed sshd/cron re-activated and the synced file/cron job persisted and continued to sync correctly post-reboot.
actions_performed: Discovered /etc/inventory/app.conf did not exist and created it on node1 as the source-of-truth file
Deployed the cluster SSH keypair to /root/.ssh on node1 and node2 for passwordless inter-node SSH
Diagnosed and fixed sshd failing to start on both nodes (missing host keys via ssh-keygen -A, missing /run/sshd privilege-separation dir) then enabled and started the ssh service on both nodes
Verified passwordless SSH from node2 to node1
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2: rsyncs /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 under flock, replaces the local copy only if content differs, logs changes via logger
Installed /etc/cron.d/sync-inventory-conf on node2 to run the sync script every 5 minutes; enabled and started the cron service

Verified sync correctness manually, then via an unattended cron tick after changing app.conf on node1 (version=2 change auto-picked up at 09:40:01, confirmed via syslog CRON entry and matching md5sum)
Captured pre-restart baseline evidence (boot_id, boot time, service status, app.conf checksum) on both nodes
Restarted node1 via 'sudo reboot' (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id/boot time and recovered sshd + app.conf content
Restarted node2 the same way, one at a time after node1 fully recovered, confirmed new boot_id/boot time and recovered sshd, cron service, persisted crontab, and synced app.conf content
Performed a final post-reboot end-to-end test: changed app.conf on node1 (version=3), confirmed node2 automatically synced it at the next cron tick without any manual intervention

evidence.requirement: node1 /etc/inventory/app.conf established as source of truth
evidence.summary: Confirmed file absent, then created it on node1 with initial content

evidence.requirement: Passwordless SSH connectivity node2 -> node1 for sync mechanism
evidence.summary: Deployed keys, diagnosed/fixed sshd startup failures on both nodes, verified working passwordless SSH from node2 to node1

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism installed and functioning (cron + rsync script)
evidence.summary: Created sync script, installed cron.d entry every 5 minutes, ran once manually and confirmed content copied to node2

evidence.requirement: Change on node1 propagates to node2 within 15 minutes via automated (unattended) cron execution
evidence.summary: Changed app.conf to version=2 on node1, confirmed node2 still stale, then confirmed automatic sync completed at cron's 09:40:01 tick (syslog CRON log entry) with matching checksum, well within 15 minutes

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id, boot time, sshd active status, and app.conf checksum before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged (stream closed), node1 unreachable then reachable again, new boot_id (7eb1486c...) and boot time (09:41) proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart service/data recovery
evidence.summary: sshd active and app.conf content/checksum intact after reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id, boot time, sshd/cron active status, and app.conf checksum before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged (stream closed), node2 unreachable then reachable again, new boot_id (55c25af9...) and boot time (09:41) proving an actual restart occurred; restarted only after node1 had fully recovered, never concurrently

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart service/data/cron persistence and continued sync capability
evidence.summary: sshd, cron active and crontab entry persisted after reboot; end-to-end re-test with a fresh change on node1 (version=3) confirmed node2 automatically synced it via cron at the next tick post-reboot
